derivation.graph_digest: canonical SHA-256 of the immutable legacy manifests and evidence collections
derivation.evidence_set_digest: canonical SHA-256 of the immutable legacy evidence collection
derivation.profile_bindings: environment.profile from each legacy Evidence record at source_commit
derivation.authority_skill_sbom: values or bytes fixed at source_commit
derivation.skill_eval: legacy skill-eval Artifact bytes and observed pass_rate at source_commit
derivation.provenance_digest: SHA-256 of this adapter provenance Artifact

limitations: このAdapterは旧custom Certificate自体をCore Certificateだったものとして書き換えない。
このAdapterは当時の有限Coverageに対するbounded-complete履歴だけを表し、subject-definitive昇格や現在EvidenceのClosureを証明しない。
旧形式に存在しなかったfieldはsource commitの固定Artifactまたは本migration provenanceから導出し、mapping Evidenceなしに再解釈しない。
